title: Banach lattices with upper $p$-estimates: Renorming and factorization
summary: The notions of $p$-convexity and concavity are fundamental tools for studying Banach lattices, as they partition the class of Banach lattices into a scale of spaces with $L_p$-like properties. Upper and lower $p$-estimates provide a refinement of this scale, modeled by the Lorentz spaces $L_{p,\infty}$ and $L_{p,1}$, respectively. In this article, we provide a comprehensive treatment of Banach lattices with upper $p$-estimates.
